set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Sampled GW is compared with dense over budgets and seeds.
- Rank approximation error/time is measured over ranks.
- Quality generally improves with budget within stochastic tolerance.
- Unusable budgets warn or fail explicitly.
- Memory scaling covers dense, coordinate-native, and graph paths.
- Docs claim only the certified envelope.
set.title: Certify sampled and approximate methods by quality-versus-budget curves
